name: Zolve - Verify Razorpay Payment Signature Workflow

parameters.query:
UPDATE payments SET status = 'CAPTURED', razorpay_payment_id = $1, razorpay_signature = $2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE razorpay_order_id = $3;
UPDATE bookings SET booking_status = 'CONFIRMED', payment_status = 'CAPTURED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $4;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ verified: true, message: 'Payment verified and booking confirmed successfully' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ verified: false, error: 'Signature verification failed' }) }}
